reason: The trigger lives on cards.team-spend, the parent of the sampled state. Tab reaches the Assign budget to employees button in the Team Lunch row (the sweep's trace stopped on the table row that holds the button and pressed Enter and Space there), and on the button itself both Enter and Space open the Assign Team Lunch dialog and move focus into it.

The flagged listbox is an empty, 0x0 fixed-position live region (aria-live polite, no children, no options, empty aria-owns) that announces selected members; there is nothing in it to operate.
